newsitem.title: SPAIN: TENNIS-SEEDS CONTINUE TO FALL IN MARBELLA.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS-SEEDS CONTINUE TO FALL IN MARBELLA.

text.p: The Marbella tennis tournament lost another of its favourites on Wednesday when third-seeded Alberto Berasategui was beaten by teenage qualifier Fernando Vicente, a player ranked nearly 200 places below him.
Berasategui took the first set in a tie-break but his 19-year-old Spanish compatriot fought back to win 6-7 (5-7) 6-2 7-5.
Sixth seed Francisco Clavet, also of Spain, had earlier lost in straight sets to Germany's Marc Goellner and seventh-seeded Javier Sanchez had fallen to Norway's Christian Ruud.
Ruud will face Felix Mantilla, who lived up to his second-seeding by beating fellow Spaniard Jordi Burillo 7-5 6-3.
The tournament lost top seed Alberto Costa and fifth seed Carlos Moya on Tuesday.
